excluded_responsibilities: Transition weights, crop/transform/opacity evaluation, dissolve/composition, text, legacy vector v1, temporal media decode, encoding, persistence and publication remain outside this provider add-on.
failure_semantics: Unknown transition/role/scope, inactive time, wrong clip or asset, mismatched local/source time, profile/hash/viewport drift, cancellation or unavailable cached surface fails closed with a zero frame. The visible-only v1 Frame contract is never widened.
ownership_semantics: Compile freezes transition scopes together with clip scopes. Provider calls are concurrent immutable reads; returned Surfaces remain provider-owned and receipts contain no caller-owned mutable storage.
request_semantics: Require the exact frozen document hash and complete timeline/track/transition/clip/asset IDs and indexes, vector track/asset kinds, transition profile, outgoing or incoming role, semantic source hash, intrinsic viewport, actual evaluator timeline/local/source handle time and the complete expression/raster/paint/kernel/surface profile chain.
resource_semantics: Compile retains transition-handle scopes only for non-zero active windows, checks cancellation while indexing them and caps the two role scopes per transition at twice MaxClipScopes. A compact clip-key index and compact handle records reference the already bounded authoritative clip scopes; zero-width hard cuts retain no handle scope.
response_semantics: Echo every v2 request field exactly and return the same cached immutable intrinsic Surface, canonical semantic source hash, complete raster receipt and independently bindable surface identity used by the visible-only provider.
time_semantics: Accept only actual samples in the transition's half-open active [cut-pre_duration,cut+post_duration) window. The role must select the authored outgoing or incoming clip, and local/source times must equal exact evaluator mappings at that same TimelineTime even when the clip is outside its ordinary visible interval. Visible-time clamping and edge-frame substitution are forbidden.
